messages:
jamie: Heads-up - I hit a subtle eval flip on a quant rollout. Looks tied to kernel tie-breaking. Not urgent but annoying.
noor: can you share a concrete diffs sample? prefer inline short examples to triage quickly.
jamie: pasted minimal repro in CI: prompt "Explain RBAC for tenants". golden before vs after changed phrasing; KL up ~10% on some tokens.
seq-bot: (automated) run 882233 enqueued: golden-compare with current kernel policy.
paul: policy question: for onboarding should we require a deterministic compare mode or allow wider tolerances?
iris: prefer deterministic compare for canonical admission. Otherwise we lose root cause signal.
noor: ok proposal: bench-runner supports a dual-smoke mode: run canonical with FORCED_LEGACY_KERNEL, then run candidate with current policy, diff delta must be below X% tokens. If not, fail onboarding.
jamie: sounds good. we also should snapshot the selected seed examples so postmortems are reproducible.
paul: operationally add a lightweight gating flag in intake manifest: dual_kernel_smoke: optional|required. Default optional for dev models, required for prod tiers.
qa-bot: (automated) checklist item created: ONB-720 "dual-kernel deterministic smoke" assigned to eng-ml.
noor: next steps: 1) add FORCED_LEGACY_KERNEL env to bench-runner (jamie) 2) intake manifest flag and validation (paul) 3) snapshot selected examples by run id (iris). aim for MWF spike.
jamie: filed PR draft with bench-runner hook and test. link posted in thread. will run full golden sweep with dual-smoke after tests.
